books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: A schoolteacher wakes up alone on a spaceship light-years from home, with no memory of how he got there, and slowly realises he may be Earth's last chance against a microbe that is dimming the sun.

books.title: The Way of Kings
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: On a storm-scoured world, a slave soldier, a scholar with a secret and a highprince haunted by visions are drawn toward a war older than any of them know. The first book of the Stormlight Archive.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.subtitle: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits & Break Bad Ones
books.author: James Clear
books.description: A practical guide to how small, steady changes compound, and how to shape your surroundings so good habits are easy and bad ones are hard.

books.title: Dune Messiah
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Twelve years after taking the throne, Paul Atreides rules an empire waging holy war in his name, and the conspirators gathering around him know exactly how much he can foresee.

books.title: Fourth Wing
books.author: Rebecca Yarros
books.description: Violet Sorrengail was meant to be a scribe. Instead she is sent to the war college where dragon riders are made, and where most candidates don't survive the first year.

books.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
books.author: Gabrielle Zevin
books.description: Two friends who met as children in a hospital games room make video games together across three decades of success, rivalry and a love that never quite lines up.

books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
books.description: Between life and death, Nora Seed finds a library whose books each hold a life she could have lived, and gets the chance to try them.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.description: Klara, an Artificial Friend who learns about the world from a shop window, is chosen by a sick girl and sets out to understand the people she has come to love.

books.title: Circe
books.author: Madeline Miller
books.description: The witch of Aiaia tells her own story: an unloved daughter of the sun god, exiled to an island, who learns the power of transformation and stands against gods and men.

books.title: Lessons in Chemistry
books.author: Bonnie Garmus
books.description: In the 1960s, chemist Elizabeth Zott is pushed out of her lab and ends up hosting a television cooking show, which she teaches as chemistry, to the network's alarm.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the most valuable substance in the universe, young Paul Atreides' family is handed a trap disguised as a fief.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.subtitle: or There and Back Again
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfortable hobbit, is swept off by a wizard and thirteen dwarves on a quest to reclaim a treasure guarded by a dragon.

books.author: George Orwell
books.description: Winston Smith rewrites history for the Ministry of Truth in a state that watches everything, and begins, dangerously, to keep a diary.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy take an instant dislike to each other, and spend the rest of the novel finding out how wrong first impressions can be.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: Nick Carraway spends a summer on Long Island beside his mysterious neighbour Jay Gatsby, whose lavish parties are all aimed at one woman across the bay.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
books.author: Brandon Sanderson

series.name: The Mistborn Saga: The Original Trilogy

books.description: In a world of ash and mist ruled by an immortal emperor, a street thief discovers she can burn metals for power and joins a crew planning an impossible heist.

books.title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
books.author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
books.description: A reclusive Hollywood icon chooses an unknown journalist to write her life story, including the truth about her seven marriages.

books.title: Educated
books.subtitle: A Memoir
books.author: Tara Westover
books.description: A memoir of growing up in a survivalist family in rural Idaho, never going to school, and of the education that took Tara Westover to Cambridge and away from home.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Left for dead on Mars when his crew evacuates, astronaut Mark Watney has to engineer his way to survival with limited food and a lot of duct tape.

books.title: Infinite Jest
books.author: David Foster Wallace
books.description: Set at a tennis academy and a halfway house in a near-future North America, a sprawling novel about addiction, entertainment and a film so engaging that its viewers lose the will to do anything else.

books.title: Ulysses
books.author: James Joyce
books.description: One day in Dublin, 16 June 1904, following Leopold Bloom and Stephen Dedalus through the city in a novel that changes its style with every chapter.

books.title: Moby Dick
books.author: Herman Melville
books.description: Ishmael signs on to the whaler Pequod, whose captain, Ahab, is set on hunting down the white whale that took his leg.

books.title: Children of Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Paul's twin children, born with the memories of their ancestors, inherit an empire held in trust by their aunt and a desert planet that is turning green.

books.title: God Emperor of Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Thousands of years later, Leto II rules as a tyrant slowly becoming a sandworm, holding humanity to a path that only he can see.

books.title: The Cruel Prince
books.subtitle: Collector's Edition
books.author: Holly Black
books.description: Stolen away to the High Court of Faerie as a child, a mortal girl decides that if she can't be safe among the fey, she can at least be dangerous, and is drawn into a plot against the crown.

editions.publisher: Little, Brown Books for Young Readers

books.title: Edgedancer
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: A short novel between the second and third Stormlight books: a restless young thief with a gift for slipping through the world chases a rumour across a continent, and learns what it costs to listen.

books.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
books.subtitle: The Lord of the Rings: Part One
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: A quiet hobbit inherits a plain gold ring and learns it is the one thing a dark lord needs, so he leaves home with a few friends on a long walk to destroy it.

books.title: The Lord of the Rings
books.subtitle: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Two Towers, The Return of the King
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: All three parts of the story in one volume: the fellowship's journey south, its breaking, and the war that decides whether the ring can be unmade.

library.private_notes: Borrowed from the library, due back on the 30th.
Second time through. Read it again before the next film.

review.markdown:
Better the second time. The opening is slow, but once the politics, the desert and the spice start to fit together I couldn't put it down.

What stood out on this read:

- how much is left unsaid between the characters
- the appendices, which I skipped the first time

On to *Dune Messiah*.
I gave up at page 140. I enjoyed the chapters at sea, but the long detours into whale anatomy lost me. I'd like to try again some winter, maybe as an audiobook.
